lina: Anyone watching the Derby tonight? absolute chaos in the second half lol
sam: Yep. Took a flyer on the 3-1 upset. $5 on the books. If it hits I buy lunch :moneybag:

jess: Count me in. Also my fantasy team is crying, so tacos = therapy. :sob::taco:
sam: Quick poll: :taco: or :burrito:? react with emoji to vote.
devon: also can someone grab the order link later? I’m heads-down on a deploy.
lina: I'll post the order. Thinking El Sombrero: classics + a couple veggie packs. Order snippet: ```
3 carne asada tacos
2 pollo asado tacos
1 large chips & guac
2 veggie tacos
```
sam: Perfect. If the longshot loses I'm still buying chips & guac because that goal was beautiful.
ops-bot: Reminder: calendar RSVP for "Noon Taco Pickup" created by lina.
jess: streaming link for the match? anyone have a good one?
devon: https://stream.example.com/derby - 30s delay, mute if at desk :grimacing:
lina: OK plan: watch, react, loser (or winner?) buys. See you at 12 if the stars align. :crossed_fingers:
